topics.name: Inflation
topics.explanation: Inflation means prices generally increase over time, reducing the purchasing power of money.

topics.name: Compounding
topics.explanation: Compounding means growth can build on previously accumulated amounts over time.
topics.warning: Examples are hypothetical and do not guarantee future returns.

topics.name: SIP
topics.explanation: A Systematic Investment Plan allows an investor to invest a fixed amount at regular intervals. SIPs do not guarantee returns.

instruction: Explain financial concepts using simple language and practical examples. Do not recommend specific financial products.
